description: This PHP source file defines the ViewEmployeeAttendanceController class within the OrangeHRM system. The class manages the pre-render logic for the employee attendance view, including authorization checks, assembling data components, and setting properties for detailed or summary attendance views based on request parameters.

classes.name: ViewEmployeeAttendanceController
